notes.title: Shadowhand Solitaire - Multi-Language Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/afa193882a6afa3257d6f6d873514bf160ed77f3.png"]

You can now change language for Shadowhand Solitaire on Steam via the options screen. 

Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.

Enjoy playing Shadowhand Solitaire in your chosen language!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199380/Shadowhand_Solitaire/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: V1.12 Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue when rapidly clicking the stock pile and obtaining a wildcard.
- Fixed saver achievement so it triggers at >=50000 instead of >50000.
- Deleted Dialogs/MoreGamesDialog.png as it wasn't being used.
- Changed Shadowhand to Shadowhand Solitaire on the More Games dialog.
- Added a Shadowhand Solitaire news popup (only shows once) and a slide on news icon to the title screen. We've done this because the best way to let our fans know about our new games is via cross-promotion from the older games and, as an indie micro-studio, every little thing we can do helps.

notes.title: Update V1.11 Multi-language support!
notes.notes:
- You can now change language via the options screen. Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese.

Please note: at present we do not plan to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio and cannot afford to do so, but we welcome fan translations if people want to do that.

notes.title: Update V1.10
notes.notes: - Steam Deck fix: The on-screen keyboard will now appear automatically when the player is prompted to enter their name, including in Offline Mode.

notes.title: Update V1.09
notes.notes: - You can now pass in command line arguments (Steam Launch Options) to change the save data location as follows: SaveInDocuments or SaveInAppData or SaveInCGames or SaveInExeFolder

notes.title: Update V1.08 (Steam Deck enhancements)
notes.notes:
V1.08
Steam Deck enhancements:
- Tapping the wildcard fan will now bring up a wildcard selection panel to make it easier to select an individual wildcard.
- The on-screen keyboard will now appear automatically when the player is prompted to enter their name.
- Boosted the font size in various places if running on Steam Deck.
- Replaced "Click to continue" on the first story dialog with "Tap to continue" and made it larger.
- Replaced "Click" in all tutorial text with "Tap".
- If "Exit Game" is used via the Steam button the game will no longer say "Sorry the game didn't close properly last time." on next boot.
- Hid the "Set as Wallpaper" button on Steam Deck because it's not applicable.

General:
- Improved Steam Cloud support so that the first time you play on another device it will pick the first profile in the profile list instead of using a blank profile.

V1.05-V1.07
- Game Name (on Window title bar) now includes Collector's Edition.
- Locked wallpapers now say "Locked" instead of "???"
- Deleted unused VO1a.ogg file 
- Fixed an issue where the Resume Chapter dialog showed the wrong chapter number if you were previously playing a Collector's Edition chapter and had just loaded the game.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update V1.04
notes.notes:
- Added Cast Biographies screen.
- Added Music Player screen.
- Added Customise screen where you can change card backs.
- Added Collector's Edition Extras panel and buttons to Main Menu.

Enjoy!

notes.title: V1.03 Update
notes.notes:
- Added a wallpapers button to the main menu that allows you to set unlocked wallpapers as your Windows desktop wallpaper.
- Added Collector's Edition Wallpaper files.
- Fixed some typos in the story and shop screen dialogs.
- Made Shadowhand music on Chapter 9 and 15 louder and deleted two duplicate music files.
- Deleted CEMapBackground.jpg as it was unused.
- Deleted OptionsBackgroundOld.jpg

notes.title: V1.02 Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where the tooltip for the Cascade (Waterfall) powerup described what it did, even if you hadn't purchased it. Now it says "keep playing to unlock".
- Fixed a bug where returning from the Collector's Edition shop screen went back to the base game map screen.
- Updated credits.
- Changed Confirm! to Please Confirm on confirmation dialogs.
- Simplified Restart Hand message.
- Changed Quit Hand button to say Main Menu.
- Changed Main Menu and Exit to Desktop messages to make it clear that the chapter can be resumed.
- Clicking Newsletter and More Games no longer closes the game to open the browser unless you are in full screen mode.
- In Hard mode you will be warned if you didn't get a perfect hand and clicked Next.

notes.title: V1.01 Update
notes.notes:
- Shows a "Powerups Reminder" tutorial dialog on hand 3-3 in case players forgot about them.
- Updated credits
- Steam: Fixed an issue where running the game for the first time would show a dialog saying "Sorry, the game didn't close properly last time."
- Graphics Driver is now shown on the options screen.
